method: Sequential post-A01 then D54 local HTTP-mock built runs; 5 cache-disabled samples per Home/Auth/Plan/Fund at 1440/402. Unthrottled localhost and CPU1, fixed observation cutoff. Not production p75/INP or approved SLA. Compare range/noise, not just medians.

environment.cache: disabled and cleared before each target navigation

limits: HTTP mocks only; authenticated bootstrap pre-established for Plan/Fund.
One-second observation after fonts and visible image decode; late activity beyond cutoff not measured.
Event Timing samples >=16ms are not page-lifetime INP; absent entries do not mean zero.
No approved PERF01 SLA or production/real-device claim; no real network/provider latency.
